idea-plugin.name: Reclazz
idea-plugin.description:
Free Hot-Reload for Spring & Java Applications

Reclazz eliminates server restarts during development. Edit your Java code, build, and see changes applied instantly in the running JVM, including Spring bean refresh, MVC re-scan, cache eviction, and more.

Key Features

  • Instant Hot-Swap: Redefines classes via the Instrumentation API in milliseconds
  • Spring Bean Refresh: Automatically destroys and recreates singleton beans after reload
  • MVC Re-scan: Re-registers @RequestMapping methods when controllers change
  • Cache Eviction: Evicts Spring caches for @Cacheable/@CacheEvict classes
  • Scheduler Reload: Cancels and re-registers @Scheduled tasks
  • Structural Changes: Add/remove methods and fields on any JDK 17+ (JBR/DCEVM additionally give full reflective visibility)
  • SAP Commerce Support: Interceptor reload, ImpEx auto-import, extension-aware
  • JDK Auto-Detection: Detects JDK 17/21 and JBR/DCEVM, auto-configures JVM flags
  • One Click Setup: Once enabled, the agent is injected into run configurations for you
  • 100% Local & Private: No telemetry, no analytics, no outbound network requests

How It Works

  1. Reclazz asks once whether to turn on. It ships switched off, because enabling it puts an agent into the JVM that runs your code
  2. Run your application. The agent is injected automatically (SAP Commerce servers start outside the IDE, so Reclazz offers to add it to the wrapper config instead)
  3. Edit code, build your project. Changes are hot-swapped instantly

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2024.1+
  • JDK 17+

idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.1

Marketplace review fixes. No change to what the plugin does.

  • Looks the plugin up through the public PluginManager API rather than an internal one
  • Guarantees the packaged agent is the shaded jar, which carries the dependencies it loads at startup

1.0.0

First public release.

  • Hot-swaps Java classes into a running JVM: method bodies, and adding or removing methods and fields on any JDK 17+
  • Refreshes Spring beans, re-scans MVC mappings, evicts caches, re-registers scheduled tasks and event listeners
  • Purpose-built SAP Commerce support: extension-aware watching, interceptor reload, ImpEx auto-import, items.xml and beans.xml regeneration
  • Validated end to end against a live SAP Commerce 2211 server
